title: 2008 HMMT November Guts Problem 5
statement: What is the sum of all integers \(x\) such that \(|x+2| \leq 10\) ?

solutions.text: \(\quad-42\) The inequality \(|x+2| \leq 10\) holds if and only if \(x+2 \leq 10\) and \(x+2 \geq-10\). So \(x\) must be in the range \(-12 \leq x \leq 8\). If we add up the integers in this range, each positive integer cancels with its additive inverse, so the sum is equal to \(-12-11-10-9=-42\).
